verdict.rationale: A government corporate-filing service could plausibly offer public APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API at all, let alone versioning or a deprecation policy: OpenAPI probes return 404, and filing runs through PDF forms, upload/fax/mail, and a CAPTCHA-gated web portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
